description: Which stocks in a market trade far above their normal volume: up to 10 names at or above a multiple of normal (default 1.5×, never lower) in the latest session, ranked by × normal, each with its sector, and how many of the market's tracked names reached it. Any of the 13 markets. Names and multiples only: no prices or price changes.

market.description: Market key or name, e.g. US, Japan or Germany. Default US. Any of the 13 markets.

min_multiple.description: The multiple of normal to reach. Default 1.5; anything lower reads as 1.5.

name: infinity_unusual_volume
title: Unusual volume
